text: ポケモンの　わざで　こわせそうだ！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　わざで

structure.en: it looks like it could be broken!

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そうだ stuck onto the stem of a verb says that is how it looks to the speaker. こわせそうだ = 'it looks like it can be broken'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing こわす to こわせる turns 'break' into 'can break'. こわせ = 'can break'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that is the tool used to do it. わざで = 'with a move'.
